*   **Long-Context Retention:** Evaluates the model's ability to maintain focus on specific data points buried within a massive volume of repetitive filler text without losing track of the core subject matter.
*   **Deterministic Retrieval Accuracy:** Tests whether the system can precisely locate and extract unique alphanumeric identifiers from a noisy environment, ensuring no hallucinations or omissions occur during extraction.
*   **Noise Resistance & Attention Span:** Measures how well the model filters out thousands of identical "neutral benchmark record" entries to isolate distinct signal markers without being distracted by the high volume of redundant context.
*   **Instruction Adherence Under Load:** Verifies that the model can follow complex formatting constraints (concise, non-repetitive bullets followed by a specific list) while processing an extremely long input sequence that approaches or exceeds typical context window limits.
*   **Memory Bandwidth Efficiency Proxy:** Serves as a qualitative proxy for memory-bandwidth-bound inference performance, checking if the underlying architecture can efficiently manage and retrieve information from unified memory structures without degradation in output quality.
